title: Reading Landscape remaining ordinary clauses independent check
scope: Read-only semantic and field-binding review of two VE/TS Reading Landscape L1 clause candidates.

rows.sourceSentence: Before digging a swale, dam, or other structure, have the site assessed.
rows.proposedSentence: Ni sa athu u bwa a swale, dam, kana tshiṅwe tshivhumbeo, itani uri fhethu hu ṱolwe.
rows.currentTargetParagraph: An A-frame level i nga ni thusa u mark points at the same height and trace a contour line. Its marks are an observation, not a design or approval for earthworks. Before digging a swale, dam, or other structure, have the site assessed. Soil, slope, drainage, storm flow na safe overflow route zwoṱhe ndi zwa ndeme. Vhudzisani a trained local adviser.
rows.reason: The candidate translates the ordinary before-digging/site-assessment instruction and retains a swale and dam as exact technical English. The timing condition and assessment instruction remain explicit; soil, slope, drainage and storm-flow factors plus the existing trained-local-adviser instruction remain unchanged. Semantic/source-binding check only, not fluent approval.
